blind.description: A small round woven wicker basket with side handles, packed with cylindrical rolls of linen bandages or cloth wrappings. A small cloth or parchment tag/strip hangs over the basket's rim. The basket has a realistic woven texture rendered in warm brown wicker, and the tightly wrapped cloth rolls are textured in off-white and beige. Surfaces are solid and well-defined with no disconnected or hovering artifacts.
blind.from_above: A circular brown woven basket filled with circular roll-ends and one tilted roll of cream-coloured bandages, with a rectangular cloth tag visible on one edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 the height of the figure (around 1 foot / 30 cm tall) and about 1.2 feet (35 cm) wide.
